definition: Repeated order actions, inspired by provider order transaction semantics; not a copy of poe.

columns.name: history_id
columns.definition: Unique occurrence identity for a repeated order action.

columns.name: object_id
columns.definition: Global object identity; distinct from local subtype order_id.

columns.name: action
columns.definition: ENTERED, REVIEWED or CANCELLED order action; repeated REVIEWED is permitted.

columns.name: occurred_at
columns.definition: Actual UTC time of the order action.

encoding_detail: Each occurrence is a separate row; action/event_txt determines activity. Technical emar.storetime is excluded.

definition: Measurement occurrences with separately charted and available-result times, inspired by MIMIC labevents.

columns.name: labevent_id
columns.definition: Unique measurement occurrence identity; repeated item measurements remain distinct.

columns.name: order_id
columns.definition: Subtype-local order identity; deliberately overlaps across the three order tables.

columns.name: itemid
columns.definition: Synthetic laboratory concept ID; no original MIMIC item code is claimed.

columns.name: charttime
columns.definition: Actual charted measurement time in labevents; medication administration/omission time in emar. Not lab result-availability time.

columns.name: storetime
columns.definition: For labevents, time result becomes available; for emar/procedureevents, system record time excluded as a separate business event.

columns.name: valuenum
columns.definition: Synthetic measurement numeric value.

columns.name: valueuom
columns.definition: Measurement unit; all current synthetic measurements use arbitrary units.

encoding_detail: Each row preserves a repeated occurrence; multiple timestamp columns emit distinct activity types within that occurrence.

definition: Medication administration or omission occurrences, inspired by MIMIC emar.

columns.name: emar_id
columns.definition: Unique synthetic dose occurrence ID; simplified from the MIMIC identity structure.

columns.name: order_id
columns.definition: Subtype-local order identity; deliberately overlaps across the three order tables.

columns.name: charttime
columns.definition: Actual charted measurement time in labevents; medication administration/omission time in emar. Not lab result-availability time.

columns.name: event_txt
columns.definition: Administered or Not Given; selects the activity of this dose occurrence.

columns.name: storetime
columns.definition: For labevents, time result becomes available; for emar/procedureevents, system record time excluded as a separate business event.

encoding_detail: Each occurrence is a separate row; action/event_txt determines activity. Technical emar.storetime is excluded.

definition: Procedure execution episodes with start/end times, inspired by MIMIC procedureevents.

columns.name: procedureevent_id
columns.definition: Authored unique procedure episode identity; not an original MIMIC column.

columns.name: order_id
columns.definition: Subtype-local order identity; deliberately overlaps across the three order tables.

columns.name: starttime
columns.definition: Actual procedure episode start.

columns.name: endtime
columns.definition: Actual procedure episode completion; NULL if ongoing.

columns.name: storetime
columns.definition: For labevents, time result becomes available; for emar/procedureevents, system record time excluded as a separate business event.

encoding_detail: Each row preserves a repeated occurrence; multiple timestamp columns emit distinct activity types within that occurrence.
